title: Analysing element 115 with Barry at S4

tellings.quote: It wasn't discovered. It's something Barry and I were working on.

plain: Bob Lazar, a man who says he worked on recovered alien craft at S4, a secret site in the Nevada desert, in 1988 and 1989, tells podcast host Jesse Michels about element 115, a super-heavy material he links to the craft. He says it was not something that had been officially discovered at the time, but something he and a coworker named Barry were analysing there, which would suggest the craft used matter unknown to science.
